# Repository

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Repository`](gmeow-Repository.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Repository>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A version-control repository — the location/hosting facet of a software project. Holds source code history, branches, tags, and refs. Distinct from the project (endeavour), the product (work), the codebase (content), and the history (events). Aligned to Software Heritage Origin and ForgeFed [`Repository`](gmeow-Repository.md) by reference.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Repository`](gmeow-Repository.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

```turtle
# --- The pipeline run as a verifiable workflow ('s model, the Workflow
# Run Crate substrate): the extraction pipeline lives in a repository, its
# workflow definition is the buildConfigUri, the run is a BuildActivity
# performed by a Builder, and the published crate is the Distribution.
ex:pipeline-repo a gmeow:Repository ;
    rdfs:label "lillith-pipeline repository"@en ;
    gmeow:repositoryType gmeow:repoTypeGit ;
    gmeow:cloneUrl "https://github.com/blackcat-informatics/lillith-pipeline.git" ;
    gmeow:webUrl "https://github.com/blackcat-informatics/lillith-pipeline" .
```
